_scriptComments.dev: Starts the Next.js development server with automatic reloads. Run with npm run dev.
_scriptComments.build: Creates an optimized production build of the Next.js application. Run with npm run build before starting the production server.
_scriptComments.postinstall: Generates Prisma Client from prisma/schema.prisma. Runs automatically after dependency installation; can also be run with npm run postinstall. Does not apply database migrations.
_scriptComments.start: Starts the Next.js production server using an existing production build. Run npm run build first, then npm start.
_scriptComments.lint: Runs the Next.js ESLint checks to report code quality and framework rule violations. Run with npm run lint.
_scriptComments.version:patch: Bumps the patch version in package.json and package-lock.json for small releases, without creating a Git commit or tag.
_scriptComments.version:minor: Bumps the minor version in package.json and package-lock.json for feature releases, without creating a Git commit or tag.
_scriptComments.version:major: Bumps the major version in package.json and package-lock.json for the stable 1.0.0 launch or later breaking releases, without creating a Git commit or tag.
_scriptComments.db:seed: Creates or updates the SUPER admin using .env credentials; preserves existing records. Sample products are added only when SEED_SAMPLE_PRODUCTS=true.
_scriptComments.db:fresh-start: Deletes admins, login challenges, auth rate limits, orders, order items, and products; creates one SUPER admin from .env. Preserves shipping rates, migration history, and storage images.
